skill_name: Outline the steps required to create an Internet of Things (IoT) compatible device.
workflow: The steps required to create an IoT compatible device involve: (1) developing a basic prototype of the device and identifying the potential uses; (2) selecting an appropriate set of communication protocols to ensure communication between the device and the cloud; (3) determining the data that the device should be collecting and how it should be stored; (4) creating a secure connection between the device and the cloud; (5) testing the device to determine its functionality; (6) providing visual UI
